scene: Atop the steps, a bustling three-way transit terrace overlooks the city.
picture: Side view of a cobblestone transit terrace along one level ground line. Left, the grandfather pushes his plant-laden bicycle. Far left, a green garden tram draped in ivy waits. Centre, a red retro streetcar stands with open doors. Far right, a sleek yellow bento express locomotive sits ready beside a conductor waving a lantern.
shown: a green wooden tram festooned with flowering vines waiting far left
a red retro streetcar with its folding doors open in the centre
a sleek yellow express engine puffing steam at the platform far right
